By the [[time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="Friends" /> in [[0 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Friends Like These]]'' establishes that the [[Battle of Xorrn]] and its subsequent events take place sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin]], which is dated to [[0 ABY]] according to ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''.</ref> an '''Imperial fortress''' was established on<ref name="Friends" /> the [[planet]]<ref name="Supply Lines">{{TCW|Supply Lines}}</ref> [[Ryloth]]. The base of operations for [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Grand Moff]] [[Ravik]], the [[fortress]] was utilized by a planetary [[Ryloth garrison|garrison]] of [[Imperial Military]] forces stationed on Ryloth. During the war, not long after a [[Battle of Xorrn|battle]] on the planet [[Xorrn]], the Imperial fortress was infiltrated by [[Agent]] [[Nath Alico]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Rebel Alliance Intelligence Service|intelligence service]], on her mission to retrieve Imperial information for the Alliance.<ref name="Friends" />
